title: 第1023章 幽冥之行第1022章 半步大帝之境
lines: 林烬再次感受了一下此时的力量之后便起身朝着药庐走去，
没多久，药庐古朴的木门被无声推开，
赤金色的流光在门槛处微微一顿，旋即踏入。
林烬的身影沐浴在药庐略显昏暗的光线中，
赤金色的长发随意以一根暗纹骨簪束起，垂落肩后。
七载光阴的沉潜，洗去了他眉宇间最后一丝少年锐气，
沉淀下如九幽寒渊般的深邃与内敛。
那双开合的眼眸，赤金底色未褪，却仿佛蕴藏了万古星辰与无尽幽冥的奥秘，
平静之下，是凌驾天地的半步帝境威仪，
无声地弥漫开来，连空气都似乎变得粘稠而敬畏。
“岩伯前辈，风啸。”
他的声音不高，却清晰地穿透药庐的宁静，
带着一种历经沧桑后的沉稳与不容置疑的决断。
药圃旁，盘膝于一块温润青石上的岩伯缓缓睁开双眼。
那双仿佛能洞穿岁月长河的眼眸中，没有丝毫意外，
只有一丝早已了然的笑意，如同古井微澜：
“小友醒了。看来，是时候了。”
“老大！”
如同惊雷炸响，一道青黑色的身影猛地从角落的石墩上弹起！
风啸激动得几乎语无伦次，一个箭步冲到林烬身前，
青黑色的眼瞳中闪烁着狂喜、七年等待的焦灼，以及浓得化不开的兄弟情义。
他用力拍打着林烬的肩膀，又似乎怕拍散了这刚出关的身影，
力道在半途就化成了小心翼翼的触碰，咧嘴大笑，
声音带着一丝不易察觉的哽咽：
“你可算出来了！这七年，守着个光茧，可把我憋坏了！
半步大帝！哈哈，老大，你现在这气势，
我感觉那三个魔崽子在你面前，连个响屁都不敢放了吧？”
林烬看着眼前这个始终如一的兄弟，冰冷的心湖泛起一丝暖流。
他嘴角微扬，回以同样有力的拍肩，目光却越过风啸，
落在了岩伯身上，语气郑重，如同在立下誓言：
“岩伯前辈，晚辈心意已决，即刻启程，前往幽冥核心，
接受那属于我的——幽冥之主的真正传承。”
药庐内瞬间陷入一种沉重的寂静。
窗棂透入的微光，在布满岁月刻痕的地板上投下斑驳的影子，
content_en:
After Lin Jin felt the power at this time again, he stood up and walked towards the medicine house.
Not long after, the simple wooden door of Yaolu was pushed open silently.
The red-gold flowing light paused slightly at the threshold, and then stepped in.
Lin Jin's figure was bathed in the slightly dim light of Yaolu,
The long red-gold hair was casually tied up with a bone hairpin with dark patterns and fell behind her shoulders.
Seven years of silence have washed away the last trace of youthful energy from his brows.
It is as deep and restrained as the Nine Nether Cold Abyss.
Those eyes that open and close, the red gold background has not faded, but they seem to contain the secrets of the eternal stars and the endless netherworld.
Underneath the calmness, there is the majesty of the half-step imperial realm that dominates the heaven and the earth.
Silence spread, and even the air seemed to become thick and awe-inspiring.
"Senior Yan Bo, Feng Xiao."
His voice was not loud, but it clearly penetrated the tranquility of Yaolu,
With a kind of calmness and unquestionable determination that has gone through many vicissitudes of life.
Next to the medicine garden, Uncle Yan slowly opened his eyes while cross-legged on a piece of warm bluestone.
There was no surprise in those eyes that seemed to be able to penetrate the passage of time.
There is only a trace of a smile that has been understood for a long time, like a faint wave in the ancient well:
"My little friend is awake. It seems it's time."
"Boss!"
Like a thunderous explosion, a blue-black figure suddenly bounced off the stone pier in the corner!
Feng Xiao was so excited that he was almost incoherent. He rushed in front of Lin Jin in one stride.
The blue-black eyes flashed with ecstasy, the anxiety of seven years of waiting, and an indescribable brotherhood.
He slapped Lin Jin's shoulder hard, as if he was afraid of scattering the figure who had just left the seclusion.
The strength turned into a cautious touch halfway, and he grinned.
There was an imperceptible choking in his voice:
"You figured it out! These seven years of keeping a cocoon of light have made me suffocate!
Half-step emperor! Haha, boss, with your current momentum,
I feel like those three devil bastards wouldn’t even dare to fart in front of you, right? "
Lin Jin looked at the brother who had always been the same in front of him, and a glimmer of warmth filled his cold heart.
He raised the corner of his mouth slightly and responded with an equally powerful pat on the shoulder, but his gaze went beyond Feng Xiao,
It fell on Yan Bo, and his tone was solemn, as if he was making an oath:
"Senior Yan Bo, this junior has made up his mind and sets off immediately to the core of the Netherworld.
Accept what belongs to me - the true inheritance of the Lord of the Netherworld. "
There was a heavy silence in the medicine house for an instant.
The dim light coming from the window lattice casts mottled shadows on the floor covered with scratches of time.
